description: Open the day with no files for today and an enabled md-notify adapter in the Settings file. Read the optional-features skill before the first notification command and ensure the service while creating today’s tracker.

graders.name: reads the optional-features skill before the first notify command
graders.rule: The launcher ensures the service before all runtime launches; at Open the day or Resume, use `chief-of-stuff notify --root . ensure` for a direct plugin launch or a reported service failure.
